svg.title: USAF-style Flight Duty Uniform (FDU) with blank nametag
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-fdu-flight-suit","name":"USAF-style Flight Duty Uniform (FDU) with blank nametag","size_in":{"w":47.6933,"h":41.1567},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,4769.33,4115.67],"size_source":"estimated","size_citation":"MIL-C-83141A(USAF), Coveralls, Flyer's, CWU-27/P, 8 Aug 1974, Table II (length of slide fasteners), pp. 6-7, read from the page images: size 40R front opening 28 in, breast pockets 6-1/2, left sleeve pocket 4-3/4.","size_basis":"Shape follows CAPR 39-1 Figure 8.1. The whole figure is scaled so that its front zipper (591 px at 25.55 px/in = 23.13 in) equals the 28 in front-opening slide fastener of a 40R coverall: scale factor 1.210. This is ONE linear constraint, not a pattern measurement: the spec has no finished body table, and the figure is stylised (its pockets are larger than the spec zipper lengths imply, so pocket zippers are drawn at 6.5 in and 4.75 in and the pocket panels are estimates). Nominal size 40R, chosen to match the MA-1 jacket Medium. The suit is a top only, cut about 37.5 in below the collar tips.","flag":{"side":"wearer's left sleeve (image right)","drawn":"in the garment image (flat sleeve view and, clipped to the arm, the front
